description: Put Claude Code's EnterWorktree and subagent worktrees under the project checkout-root instead of .claude/worktrees (a claude --worktree session stays native, and is flagged at session start): one hook creates them with native branch naming, base ref and .worktreeinclude copying, refuses a bad root or name loudly, and removes a clean agent worktree when the subagent stops. Opt-in per project. Release history: https://github.com/hsb3/dotfiles-agents/releases.
name: worktree-root
